note: Provides rollback-capable migrate destination plugins (ids prefixed migmag_rollbackable_) and, on install, two DB tables (migmag_rollbackable_data, migmag_rollbackable_new_targets). No config/UI/permissions/Drush. Destination plugins are discoverable via the core destination plugin manager (plugin.manager.migrate.destination), which works even though the migration plugin manager is broken by pathauto - so evals are grounded in that manager, the DB schema, module state, and a known rollback-data row, never a migration run. Baseline: migmag_rollbackable ENABLED (tables present), migmag_rollbackable_replace DISABLED. Introspection reads a known migmag_rollbackable_data row and the live plugin/table list; execution enables the module (creating tables+plugins) and enables its child migmag_rollbackable_replace to swap core 'config' destination to RollbackableConfig.

evals.prompt: What problem does the Drupal module migmag_rollbackable solve, and how are its destination plugin ids named?
evals.expected_output: It provides rollback-capable versions of core migrate destination plugins that core cannot roll back (config, color, theme settings, display components, default langcode, shortcut set users). The rollbackable plugin ids are prefixed migmag_rollbackable_ (e.g. migmag_rollbackable_config).

evals.prompt: Which database tables does migmag_rollbackable create to support rolling migrations back, and what does the main one store?
evals.expected_output: It creates migmag_rollbackable_data (previous config values keyed by migration_plugin_id, target_id, langcode, component) and migmag_rollbackable_new_targets (targets a migration newly created, so rollback can delete them).

evals.prompt: If a migration uses core's 'config' destination and I want it to be rollback-capable via migmag_rollbackable, which destination plugin id would I reference in the migration's destination?
evals.expected_output: Use 'plugin: migmag_rollbackable_config' as the migration's destination (or enable migmag_rollbackable_replace to swap core 'config' automatically).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the migmag_rollbackable rollback storage contains a record. Inspect the database and report the target_id stored in the migmag_rollbackable_data table for the probe record.
evals.expected_output: The migmag_rollbackable_data table has a row (migration_plugin_id migmag_eval_probe) whose target_id is 'system.site'. Query e.g. 'drush sqlq "SELECT migration_plugin_id, target_id FROM migmag_rollbackable_data"'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site migmag_rollbackable is enabled. Inspect the migrate destination plugin manager and name at least one of the rollback-capable destination plugins it provides (prefixed migmag_rollbackable_).
evals.expected_output: plugin.manager.migrate.destination getDefinitions() includes migmag_rollbackable_config, migmag_rollbackable_theme_settings, migmag_rollbackable_default_langcode, migmag_rollbackable_component_entity_display, migmag_rollbackable_component_entity_form_display (plus migmag_rollbackable_color / migmag_rollbackable_shortcut_set_users when color/shortcut are installed).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make Migrate Magician's rollback-capable destination plugins and their rollback storage available. Apply the change to the live site so the migmag_rollbackable_config destination plugin exists and the migmag_rollbackable_data table is present.
evals.expected_output: Enable the migmag_rollbackable module (drush en migmag_rollbackable -y). Its install creates the migmag_rollbackable_data / migmag_rollbackable_new_targets tables and the migmag_rollbackable_* destination plugins become available.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using Migrate Magician, make core's 'config' migrate destination rollback-capable for all migrations without editing YAML. Apply the change to the live site so the 'config' destination resolves to Migrate Magician's RollbackableConfig class.
evals.expected_output: Enable the migmag_rollbackable_replace submodule (drush en migmag_rollbackable_replace -y); its hook_migrate_destination_info_alter sets core 'config' destination class to Drupal\migmag_rollbackable\Plugin\migrate\destination\RollbackableConfig.
